note: The one Fatline launchpad and the one Fatliners contract, on Base. Every Fatline server, client and hatchery reads these unless its config says otherwise.

AppFactory.rules: Coins for eggs and Fatliners, one each, launched by their holder. $FATLINE first. The coin's symbol must be the surname (set when the egg goes onchain). 100% of fees to its vault, in USDC. The vault's owner sets the rent to the server's real cost (setRate, no cap); distribute() sends everything above one billing period of rent to the holder.

Fatliners.rules: Eggs: unlimited, one per FID, can't be moved (takeEgg); each carries its surname from the day it is onchain. Fatliners: hatched from an egg (hatch), at most 777, transferable. Attesters: servers that hatched; 3 signatures (or all, while fewer).
